s: strI, (guwireva । gawi + svArTe kan .) vawikA । guli iti DAqa iti ca BAzA ॥ yaTA, “pyuwikApAtAdinA vyaYjanam .” iti dAyaBAgaH ॥
v: strI vawyeva svArTe ka pfzo॰ । vawikAyAm varttulAkAre padArTe । “samudre guwikApAtaH” jyo॰ । “guwikApAtAdinA vyaYjanaM vA viBAgaH” dAyaBAgaH । “nirdDOtahAraguwikAviSadaM himAmBaH” raGuH । kabaBAve NIp guwItyapi tatrArTe ।
m: गुटिका f. a small globe or ball, Mṛcch. v, 11/12, 5
the cocoon of the silk-worm, W.
a: गुटिका — 1 A pill. --2 A round pebble, any small globe or ball; लोष्टगुटिकाः क्षिपति Mk. 5. --3 The cocoon of the silk-worm. --4 A pearl; निर्धौतहारगुटिकाविशदं हिमांभः R. 5. 70. --5 A small pustule. --Comp. --अंजनं a kind of collyrium.

v: na॰ “gErikaM sEnDavaM kfzRAM nAgaraYca yaTottaram । dviguRaM pizwamadBistuguwikAYjanamizyate” suSrutokte 1 aYjanaBede । guwikA vawikA taTABUtamaYjanamityarTaH । “aYjanaM kriyate yena taddravyamaYjanaM matam । raso vawI taTA cUrRamiti triviDamaYjanam” BAvapra॰ । suSrute'pi “vawikArasacUrRRAni triviDAnyaYjanAni ca” ।
m: गुटिका˚ञ्जन (˚काञ्˚) n. collyrium formed like a globe or ball, Suśr.
गुटिका—मुख mfn. having a rounded orifice, iv, 35, 6.
गुटिका—पात m. falling of the ball i.e. drawing lots.
गुटिका˚स्त्र (˚कास्˚) n. a bow from which balls of clay are thrown, Vāsav. 461
गुटिकी-कृत mfn. formed into a pill, Suśr. i, 44.
